name: Basic Route Selection
brief: From three providers — one of them offline — route every payment through the cheapest online one.
context: Providers A, B and C are connected. C is offline. Choose the lowest fee among those that are online.
narrative: YamusaPay now has three providers. C is offline and must never be used. Among the rest, pick the lowest fee and clear the queue without a single failed payment. This is the everyday job of a routing engine: filter to what works, then optimize.
objective: Process every payment with no failures, using the cheapest online provider.
learningObjective: Rule engines: apply an availability constraint, then a cost preference, across several options.
intelligenceExplanation: Start from empty. The provider cards show that B is the lower-fee available provider while C is offline. Author the routing rule that clears the queue.
hint: WHEN onlineB → DO route-b. B is the cheaper available provider here.
hints: One provider is offline — do not route there.
B stays online and is the cheaper provider here.
